title: Confessions
supportedClaims: Confessions works because it admits that even universal truths about money still have to be applied through a personal lens.
Housel distinguishes between advice that is broadly durable and the private weighting each person gives to independence, cash, simplicity, and ambition.
The reader is asked to move from borrowed maxims toward a plan that can be defended in their own words and lived without constant role-play.
caution: Personalizing a plan should not become a shield for vanity, convenience, or avoiding universal constraints like risk, fees, and time.
